The '''Rett II orbital defense force''' was a [[Jante]] military force to defend its interests in the [[Rettna system/Legends|Rettna system]]. It engaged elements of the [[3rd Lon Flotilla|3rd]] and [[5th Lon Flotilla]]s during the [[Freda system/Legends|Freda system]] [[Battle of the Rettna system|attack]] on Jante holdings in the system.
